description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes, which implements a strategy for validating attributes of tokens within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains methods to process tokens, validate attributes, and utilize a validator object.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes
classes.description: A class implementing a strategy for validating attributes in tokens, part of the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of tokens to validate their attributes, skipping tokens that are armored or do not have attributes, and using an attribute validator object.
